metadata.name: Zod Engine
metadata.summary: Open-source multiplayer remake of the classic 1996 real-time tactical strategy game Z

content.value: The Zod Engine is an open-source remake and multiplayer expansion of Z, the classic 1996 real-time tactical strategy game created by The Bitmap Brothers. It faithfully restores the fast-paced territory capture and unit-manufacturing mechanics of the original game while modernizing the engine for contemporary platforms.

Unlike traditional real-time strategy games focused on resource harvesting and base building, gameplay revolves around aggressive territorial conquest where capturing sector flags directly controls production factories and unit reinforcement timers.

items.value: Authentic real-time tactical strategy gameplay recreating original unit physics, vehicle driving mechanics, and robot AI behaviors
Multiplayer network support allowing cooperative and competitive skirmishes with human opponents over LAN or the Internet
Sector-based territory domination system where holding command flags governs factory production and map control
Diverse battlefield environments featuring destructible obstacles, artillery, tanks, and infantry robot squads
Cross-platform game engine optimized for low latency and standalone execution on modern Linux systems
